column1: # Custom partition table for the Music Controller (4 MB flash
# Default IDF table only gives 1 MB to the app
# WiFi + mbedTLS + LVGL are linked in. This gives 2 MB to the app and
# 256 KB to a LittleFS partition that holds the live nowplaying.jpg
# downloaded from Spotify (carved out of internal flash because the
# CYD's SD card is on SPI3_HOST + needs DMA
# channels left -- LCD already owns both).
